Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL1133765. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to include canonical SMILES. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1133765'. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
